waivers_recommended.subject: C1B bulk-tap pour channels 1.11+1.25mm (P7 disclosure)
waivers_recommended.basis: not in series with the 5A path (dead-end stub off the pour); worst realistic current 0.3A for ~0.5ms at PD slew vs 3.49A continuous capacity of the 1.11mm channel alone (pipeline IPC model); combined 2.36mm exceeds the net's own 1.75mm rule; no converter, no sustained ripple duty

violations.msg: 5A return choke: GND contact pad A1-B12 (2 of 4 GND contacts, ~2.5A) reaches the B.Cu return pour only through a 0.2mm x 2.7mm F.Cu chain into shell pad 1's barrel (+1 via grazing the pad corner by ~0.05mm). 0.2mm at 2oz = 0.80A capacity at 10C rise; model gives ~133C at 2.5A. Architecture D7's structural substitute ('>=10 vias at J1 GND pads') not implemented; invisible to DRC (netclass-legal) and check_current (GND undeclared). Fix: F.Cu GND spandrel bonding pad to shell pad 1 + 4-5 vias (free strip above pour top edge y<39.7).

5A return choke: GND contact pad B1-A12 (~2.5A) ties to the pour through a 0.2mm x 1.3mm trace into ONE 0.6/0.3 via (board's own via_amps 0.5 budget demands 5). Shell pad 4 is 0.32mm away but unconnected on F.Cu. Same blind spot and same cheap fix as the top pad (bond to shell pad 4 + vias south of y46).

Safety/waiver silk absent (board has ZERO gr_text): 'AUX 1A MAX' + V+/GND at J3 (P0 answer 4 'silk-marked', V10); 'PD SOURCES ONLY' (ERC waiver W1's standing condition, promised on B.SilkS); J2 screw polarity unmarked (trunk lands on pad 1 = lower screw; reverse-wiring a 100W bench output is the easiest field mistake this board can cause). check_silk gates legibility of existing silk only; no check enforces content; constraints.json has no silk key.

User-interface silk absent: five-row profile table on B.SilkS (D3 calls silk 'the user interface'; B.Cu pour is clear and roomy); LED legends PWR / 5V ONLY / PROFILE OK (the whole P0-answer-6 fallback-indication scheme is mute labeled D3/D5/D6); e-marked-cable disclaimer (V10). Present: SW1 footprint's own ON + 1 2 3 compact marker. Without the table the ON/OFF-to-voltage map exists only off-board (bounded fail-safe: open/wrong resolves >= 5V).

USB-C mouth recessed ~0.4-0.5mm behind the board edge (courtyard/silk front x=10.18 vs edge x=9.8; flagged at P6). Thick plug overmolds can butt the edge and hold the plug short of latch: intermittent CC / no PD with some cables. Nudge J1 -x 0.5-1.0mm at P9 or accept with an order-doc note.

Outline 48x30mm exceeds architecture D9's hard ceiling 48x28 by 2mm in Y (equals P0 answer 5's literal +20% but +44% area vs the brief's 40x25 target); growth past D9 undisclosed in digests. Cost/footprint consequence only - disclose at the human checkpoint.

J2's 5A GND pad ties to the return pour through 4x0.5mm thermal spokes (2.0mm total, model 8C rise at 5A). Functional but the most-loaded return necks after J1, at a hand-soldered THT joint. Recommend solid-connect override or a fat GND strap at P9; zero cost.
F1's VBUS feed branch is 18.3mm long (V8 wanted 2-3mm tap stubs hugging the run). Full 1.75mm width so V8's actual purpose is met; carries <=1A in service. Recorded as drift, no action.
Floating 0.65mm2 GND sliver (plane_repair dead-island fact, 0 anchors) between J3/SW1 clearances. Cosmetic; remove at P9 cleanup or accept.

/VAUX routed 0.3mm (7C at the declared 1.0A). At F1's max non-trip current ~1.8A the model gives 27C until trip - bounded, no damage threshold. Recorded so it is not 'fixed' blind later. Bring-up addendum: verify SW1's slide closes toward its ON label before trusting the profile map (fail-safe floor: open = 5V).
